name: Viren Samani, personal profile
note: Separate from the AI for Companies card system on purpose. The page is the publication; the profile is a person. Started from scratch 21 September 2026 after the first profile drafts read as corporate.

font.headline: Instrument Sans 700
font.serif: Newsreader 500 for one word at most

rules: One idea per card, readable at phone width without zooming.
The card must be useful on its own: a list someone screenshots, not a headline someone scrolls past.
Type is big and plain. No photographs unless Viren is in them. No stock, no offices, no icons.
One accent colour, used once or twice. Strikethrough is the signature move: the old way, crossed out.
Sign every card with the name and the two facts: ex JP Morgan, AI for Companies. Never the logo alone.
